# C# guest toolchain pins (WS-cleat2 spike, cleat#4077). Measured working 2026-11-18.

Everything below built a working component on the real engine. None of it was tested at any other version.

## Build container
- Image: `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0` pulled with `--platform linux/amd64`
- Digest: `sha256:fe0fd4e93bd2fbb47c883b7a6369e5c8d3db8bf01cdc5981f6ee35fbdf3ff4fb` (.NET SDK 10.0.404)
- Run as: `docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v <nuget-cache>:/root/.nuget -v <src>:/work -w /work <image> dotnet build -c Release`
  (`dotnet build`, NOT `dotnet publish`: the SDK's publish-after-build target makes an explicit publish circular.)

## NuGet feeds (nuget.config, <clear/> first)
- nuget.org: https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
- dotnet-experimental: https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/dnceng/public/_packaging/dotnet-experimental/nuget/v3/index.json
  (the ILCompiler.LLVM packages are ONLY on this feed)

## wasi-sdk (downloaded by the SDK package at build time, every build, to ~/.wasi-sdk)
- wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
- sha256 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 (119,441,678 bytes), computed by me from the download
- It is NOT cached unless ~/.wasi-sdk is mounted; mount a volume there in CI, or every build re-downloads 119 MB from GitHub.

## Generated by the build (informational)
- wit-bindgen 0.58.0 (named in the generated C# header)
- Project shape that built (see /private/tmp/claude-501/cs-spike/rb/rb.csproj): OutputType Library, net10.0, RuntimeIdentifier wasi-wasm, UseAppHost false, PublishTrimmed true, InvariantGlobalization true, SelfContained true, DebugType none, AllowUnsafeBlocks true; <Wit Update="wit/cleat.wit" World="cleat-workflow" />.
- Size options that worked (704 KB vs 848 KB hello): OptimizationPreference=Size, UseSystemResourceKeys=true, StackTraceSupport=false, IlcGenerateStackTraceData=false, EventSourceSupport=false.

## Host tools used for inspection (not build inputs)
- wasm-tools 1.261.0, wasmtime CLI 48.0.0 (engine uses wasmtime-go v48.0.0)

## Known facts the build chain must handle (measured, #4077)
- Output is NOT byte-reproducible (same size, different bytes across two builds).
- The component must be stamped with a cleat.metadata custom section (language "csharp"); unstamped it is detected as "python".
- Engine needs >=52 MiB per store (default 32 MiB) and version-tolerant WASI shadows before it can run: that is C# PR 3.
- Working sources: /private/tmp/claude-501/cs-spike/{rb,rb3}/Program.cs (hello, and the 9-mode test workflow); WIT: python-sdk/wit/cleat.wit at 9cf95d35.
- Docker volumes kept: cs-spike-nuget (NuGet cache, 726 MB), cs-spike-wasisdk (extracted wasi-sdk 29). Image kept: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0, python:3.12-slim.
